name: grid/job-queue
description: List all jobs on a grid node: queued, running, paused, completed, failed. Shows the full job lifecycle with alloy names, progress, and timing.

params.name: nodeId
params.description: Target node. Default: all known nodes.

results.name: jobs
results.description: Array of jobs: { jobId, alloyName, state, progress: { cycle, totalCycles, step, totalSteps }, startedAt, estimatedCompletion, nodeId }

results.name: summary
results.description: { queued, running, paused, completed, failed } counts

examples.description: Show only running jobs across all nodes
